assignment: archive-fleet-frame build-vs-ratify: (a) does the cold list poll carry archived truth so a client missing a lifecycle frame fully reconciles; (b) can the FleetHub handshake snapshot restate archived state after a hub restart, or is it in-memory-only; (c) does Studio LiveView subscribe to the fleet topic (a third reducer)?
verdict: PREMISE PARTLY WRONG. (a) YES — cold poll reconciles completely: the row carries archived_at AND the shelf filter makes absence authoritative. (b) The hub snapshot IS a fresh DB query (StudioChat.fleet_snapshot/1), so it CAN restate archived state — by ABSENCE — after any hub restart; the gap is narrower than believed: only the REPLAY arm (in-ring cursor) is archive-blind, and a hub restart forces the snapshot arm by construction. (c) NO — Studio LiveView subscribes the ACTIVITY topic, never the fleet topic; the fleet wire has exactly two client reducers (internal/chat/herd.go, apps/mobile/src/chat/herd.ts) and NEITHER folds the already-shipped D69h 'title' frame. Net: the unreplayable-frame precedent holds and the cheap arm is real, but ratify-optimistic-only is the honest arm — the only thing a frame buys is sub-poll latency, not correctness.

recipes.claim: GET /v1/chat/sessions rows carry archived_at, and the endpoint is shelf-filtered: default returns 39 rows with 0 archived; ?archived=true returns the 1 archived row with a non-null archived_at; ?scope=all is NOT a parameter (identical to default)
recipes.rerun: T=$(python3 -c "import json,os;print(json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.config/barkpark/config.json')))['token'])"); for q in '' '?archived=true' '?scope=all'; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" "https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/chat/sessions$q" | python3 -c "import json,sys;s=json.load(sys.stdin)['sessions'];print(len(s),sum(1 for x in s if x.get('archived_at')))"; done

recipes.rerun: T=$(python3 -c "import json,os;print(json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.config/barkpark/config.json')))['token'])"); A=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/chat/sessions?archived=true' | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['sessions'][0]['id'])"); curl -s --max-time 3 -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" 'https://guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/v1/chat/events' > /tmp/fleet.sse; grep -c "$A" /tmp/fleet.sse; grep -c archiv /tmp/fleet.sse
